| Arquivo | Lib | Versão | Licença |

| three.module.min.js | three.js | 0.170.0 | MIT |
| pixi.min.mjs | PixiJS | 8.21.0 | MIT |
| pixi-filters.mjs | pixi-filters | 6.1.5 | MIT |
| mediabunny.min.mjs | Mediabunny | 1.60.0 | MPL-2.0 |
| fflate.mjs | fflate | 0.8.2 | MIT |
| lucide.min.js | Lucide | 0.460.0 | ISC |
| mespeak/ | meSpeak (eSpeak) | 2.0.2 | GPL |

Modelos de IA (Whisper, CLIP, Piper, Kokoro) continuam remotos (60–300 MB) e ficam em cache no navegador.
